messages:
sara: Heads-up — brought up new reranker candidate (v3-alpha) against holdout-2026-03-10. Unquant NDCG@10=0.772, MRR=0.428.
kevin: Nice. Did you run the same harness params as previous models? seed/batching/kvpack identical?
sara: yes: seed=123, batching=auto, kvpack=true, candidates=100. PTQ int8 run shows NDCG@10=0.758 MRR=0.421 (10k holdout).
dmitri: delta looks similar to other models but higher tail. Can you share per-query delta distribution?
sara: pasted quick cdf plot in artifacts (link: https://artifacts/repro/186543). median delta ~ -0.003 but 95th pctile ~ -0.08.
jen: that tail is concerning — might be a long-doc slice. Any recent doc-join or separator changes?
sara: we switched to explicit "
***
" separator in doc concat in PR 812.
kevin: separators can change tokenization and therefore kv alignment. Try: 1) run int8 with old space-join, 2) run int8 w/kvpack=false, 3) collect top-1 switches list.
dmitri: I'll run top-k diffs and produce a small sample of queries where top1 changed. If many are long-doc queries then it's a token boundary effect.
sara: quick one-off 1k subset results: unquant NDCG@10=0.773 MRR=0.429; int8 kvpack on w/new-sep NDCG@10=0.759 MRR=0.422; int8 kvpack off w/new-sep NDCG@10=0.764 MRR=0.425; int8 kvpack on w/old-space NDCG@10=0.762 MRR=0.426.
jen: pattern: kvpack + new-sep worst. Suggests accumulation with packed kv plus shifted token offsets.
kevin: plan: sweep quant params (per-channel vs per-tensor, symmetric vs affine), and validate determinism (single-thread, batch=1). Also add a slice-by-doc-length NDCG table.
sara: assigning: kevin -> PTQ sweeps; dmitri -> top-k diffs + slice table; jen -> rerun full 10k overnight with old-space control.
ci-bot: note: job 4127 (quant-sweep) queued.
dmitri: preliminary top-k diff: 84 queries with top1 flips (of 1k); 67 of those had doc length > 1200 tokens.
kevin: that aligns. If per-tensor quant reduces error, we may prefer it for long-doc slices. Also flag for runtime team: verify kv pack layout invariant across tokenization changes.
sara: I'll open ticket INF-1209 with reproducer and small sample. Thanks all.
ci-bot: this thread will be archived in 30 days.
